_comment: FROZEN for protocol v0.1-alpha. Identical for every seat and every experimental condition (A0/B/C/D). Changing any value here forks the protocol version and invalidates cross-condition comparison with prior runs. See PREREG_A0.md section 4. BUDGET_SEARCH_SIZE lowered from 1e7 to 2e5 on 2026-08-25, before any run, so that the generator's own enumeration budget can exceed the player's by a factor of 3 or more; that gap is what makes UNRESOLVED_WITHIN_BUDGET constructible. v0.2-alpha (2026-08-26): step prose is now generated by a single renderer from each step's own check, closing the fingerprint leak measured at 84% top-1 under v0.1. This forks the protocol version, so the v0.1 A0 baseline does not carry over.
